title: David and Jonathan, Best Friends
reflectionQuestion: Jonathan and David loved each other like brothers, and stayed friends no matter what. What do you love most about your friends?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (David, secondary/short-only). The KINDNESS/friendship thread; distinct scene from 1801 (giant) + 1836 (anointing) -- this is the loyal best-friends story. Per Adam (2026-06-18): keep SAUL MOSTLY OFFSTAGE so it stays friendship, not danger -- the spear/jealousy/pursuit is softened to 'a hard time came, and David had to go far away for a while' with no villain or threat shown. Indelible image = Jonathan the prince giving David his own robe, belt, bow, sword (a true friend keeps nothing back). For a lonely / left-out child: routes to the joy of a real friend. The covenant line 'God is between us, watching over you and me' carries the not-alone spine. 'God' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_ARCHER (bold, inspiring) -- warm friendship register; rests the 4x voices.

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
